html:
Sleep Apnea

Sleep Apnea Treatment in Kansas City, MO

Are you or your partner often kept awake in the night by your loud snoring? Is sleeping throughout the night challenging for you because of difficulty breathing? If so, you may have a medical condition called sleep apnea. This condition is common, and you may already suspect you have it. We encourage you to get examined and seek treatment if you've lived with chronic snoring. Sleep apnea is potentially dangerous, but luckily, Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport can help treat it. We provide sleep apnea treatment in Kansas City, MO. Our treatments include mouth guards, which you can wear to reduce snoring, improve breathing, and get a better night's sleep.
Contact Us

Customized Sleep Apnea Mouth Guards

We develop mouth guards for patients with sleep apnea to open their air passageways and minimize snoring. Sleep apnea occurs when throat tissues change. These changes are natural and happen over time, but they can cause tissues to constrict, contract, and become abnormally obstructed. When this happens, heavy snoring and breathing problems often follow. Mouth guards carefully and gently reset the jaw to a better position, which allows throat muscles and tissues to relax. They are often preferred by patients over CPAP machines because they are easy to put in and take out, don't make noise, and use less space.

We’re Here for Your Comfort and Safety

At Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport, patient comfort and security are among our top priorities. Treatments are more successful when the patient can feel open and honest. Sleep conditions can be difficult to discuss. Our team is warm, kind, and compassionate. They've helped patients get treatment for many oral and dental-related conditions. If you think you have sleep apnea, we will examine your throat using X-ray technology and talk with you about the results. If needed, we can recommend you to other specialists like ENTs to get you the care you need. We aim to get you the treatments you need quickly so you can sleep well and stay secure throughout the night.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
